integrity: Proof is analytic; exact finite checker is corroborative. No independent audit or independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple cactus graphs, all weights strictly positive, and pairwise vertex connectivity of unrooted weighted forests only. Does not cover all series-parallel graphs, arbitrary graph topology, fixed-q random-cluster association, or full association of increasing events. Literature novelty comparisons are bounded.
title: Positive connectivity correlation and exact equality on weighted cactus forests
